transparencyFinding: Source is RGB with no alpha channel; checker-style background is baked/fake transparency.

cleanupMethod.description: Converted source to RGBA and used region 49 blank cell as the 128x128 background/checker reference. Pixels close to the blank-cell template at the same cell-relative coordinate were made transparent. Threshold was tightened after visual inspection to reduce gray-object damage.
